newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Otter temporarily scales back Tanami mine.
newsitem.headline: Otter temporarily scales back Tanami mine.

text.p: Otter Gold Mines Ltd said on Thursday it was temporarily scaling back operations at the Tanami mine to conserve fuel stocks.
It said any production shortfall in the March quarter should be redressed by increasing mining rates in the June quarter.

Resumption of full gold production would occur when full road access to the mine from Alice Springs was re-established and fuel supplies could be replenished. This was expected in early March. -- Wellington newsroom 64 4 473-4746
The Tanami mine is northwest of Alice Springs in Australia. Otter is manager of the Tanami joint venture with a 60 percent equity stake. Acacia Resources Ltd holds 40 percent.
Otter said heavy rain in late January and subsequent rainfall in February had severely restricted road access to the mine.
"Mining operations are being conducted on a reduced basis, with mill throughput scaled back and major scheduled maintenance on the treatment plant brought forward," it said.
